title: Melatonin modulates mitochondrial function and inhibits atherosclerosis progression through NRF2 activation and OPA1 inhibition.
authors: Lu, Chengbo; Lin, Quan; Guo, Xiaoli; Luo, Tan; Zhou, Han; Cai, Ziteng; Peng, Chaonan; Yang, Guangyuan; Wang, Weiqun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褪黑素通过NRF2激活和OPA1抑制改善线粒体功能以抗动脉粥样硬化，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atherosclerosis (AS), a major cardiovascular disease, is characterized by chronic inflammation and oxidative stress. Melatonin (MLT) has emerged as a potential therapeutic agent due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, although the specific mechanisms underlying its action, especially as far as mitochondrial function in AS is concerned, have yet to be fully elucidated. METHODS: In this study, ApoE(-/-) mice were fed a high-fat diet with or without MLT treatment. Aortic tissues were analyzed using hematoxylin and eosin, Masson staining, qPCR, and immunofluorescence. Oxidized low-density lipoprotein-treated RAW264.7 macrophages were assessed for AS progression, mitochondrial function, and oxidative stress using electron microscopy, Seahorse analysis, and molecular docking. RESULTS: MLT treatment significantly reduced atherosclerotic plaque formation, systemic and mitochondrial oxidative stress, and inflammation. MLT treatment was found to enhance mitochondrial function through upregulating the expression of key regulators of mitochondrial biogenesis and the activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, whereas markers of mitochondrial fusion [for example, optic atrophy protein 1 (OPA1)] were downregulated. Mechanistically, MLT was shown to directly interact with nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2), thereby activating its antioxidant pathway, which in turn regulated mitochondrial function. Additionally, OPA1 was identified as a downstream target of MLT, and its inhibition improved mitochondrial function and reduced inflammation. CONCLUSION: This study is the first to elucidate that MLT synergistically ameliorates mitochondrial dysfunction through dual mechanisms-activating the NRF2 antioxidant pathway and suppressing OPA1-mediated mitochondrial fusion-providing novel therapeutic targets for AS.
abstract_zh: 背景：动脉粥样硬化（AS）是一种主要的心血管疾病，其特征为慢性炎症和氧化应激。褪黑素（MLT）因其抗炎和抗氧化特性而成为潜在的治疗药物，尽管其作用的具体机制，尤其是在AS中涉及线粒体功能方面的机制，尚未完全阐明。方法：在本研究中，ApoE(-/-)小鼠被喂食高脂饮食，并接受或不接受MLT治疗。使用苏木精和伊红染色、Masson染色、qPCR和免疫荧光分析主动脉组织。对氧化低密度脂蛋白处理的RAW264.7巨噬细胞，通过电子显微镜、Seahorse分析和分子对接评估AS进展、线粒体功能和氧化应激。结果：MLT治疗显著减少了动脉粥样硬化斑块形成、全身性和线粒体氧化应激及炎症。研究发现，MLT通过上调线粒体生物发生关键调控因子的表达和线粒体呼吸链复合物的活性来增强线粒体功能，而线粒体融合标志物（例如视神经萎缩蛋白1（OPA1））则被下调。机制上，MLT被证明能直接与核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）相互作用，从而激活其抗氧化通路，进而调节线粒体功能。此外，OPA1被确定为MLT的下游靶点，其抑制改善了线粒体功能并减少了炎症。结论：本研究首次阐明MLT通过双重机制协同改善线粒体功能障碍——激活NRF2抗氧化通路和抑制OPA1介导的线粒体融合——为AS提供了新的治疗靶点。
